name: kpgs-audit-verify-govern
description: Audit a governed KPGS change, verify the strongest available evidence, enforce hard gates, and return an auditable decision or safe next action.

inputs.description: A governing build/workflow specification plus implementation and verifier evidence references.

outputs.description: A correlated evidence bundle with an allow, deny, promote, hold, or rollback decision.

hard_gates: No promote decision when a hard acceptance criterion fails
No raw secrets in evidence output
No fork import while provenance/license gate is unresolved

failures.user_message: The governing specification is missing. Add or select the specification before this change can be approved.
There is not enough verified evidence yet. Run the declared checks and try the governance decision again.
A required safety or governance check failed, so this change cannot be promoted.
The required verifier could not run. The result remains unproven until verification is available.
